comment: Machine-readable SSOT for cross-vendor worker dispatch (docs/model-routing.md § Cross-vendor lanes). Roles map to backends at a tier; backends map to CLI argv. argv = cmd + tier_args[role.tier] + role.args_extra. Model names NEVER appear here — each vendor's adapter/profile owns its tier (codex --profile deep = TOP-tier reasoning; kiro --agent <profile> pins its model in adapters/kiro/*.json.template). A disabled backend (enabled: false) refuses loudly with its disabled_reason — never a silent fallback. A backend carrying "gateway" reaches its vendor THROUGH that gateway's CLI rather than a first-party one: one CLI, several vendor lanes, so "vendor" stays the honest independence signal — a second opinion is only independent when its vendor differs from the dispatching session's. Kiro lanes are read-only by profile (verified: the profile's tool list overrides even --trust-all-tools), so they carry review/verify/advisor roles, never implementer.

third-opinion-review.comment: council's google lane. fallback deliberately null: falling back to kiro-openai would duplicate the codex lane's vendor and fake the independence signal — an absent lane is reported absent instead.

advisor-third.comment: opt-in perspective-diversity advisor (xai). Deliberately wired to NO gate role — advisory only, consumers opt in explicitly (/council-review --with-grok).

gemini.disabled_reason: individual OAuth sign-in retired upstream (2026-07). Decided 2026-08-19: migrate this lane to the Antigravity CLI (agy) instead of an AI Studio key. Measured 2026-08-19: agy 1.1.14 installed at ~/.local/bin/agy and the keyring is already authenticated (agy -p answers headless, no interactive login needed); current flash/pro tiers listed by 'agy models' (IDs live in the adapter tiers file); argv convention is flags BEFORE -p "prompt" (flags after are misparsed); headless print mode denied an internal command by default (fail-closed hint - formal tool-posture measurement pending). Re-enable = build an agy adapter (worker + preflight + measured posture, grok-adapter pattern), point this backend's cmd at it, then its preflight must exit 0. gemini-worker/gemini-preflight stay retired with the gemini CLI.

grok.comment: worker lane only (advisor roles) — never a gate vote. Read-only is OS-enforced by grok-worker.sh (sandbox-exec deny-write + neutral cwd): the CLI's own flags do not block writes, measured 2026-08-19 on 0.2.118 (adapters/grok/README.md). Model pin lives in adapters/grok/grok-tiers.json.template -> ~/.grok/agent-tiers.json.
